Identity, web, 3D, fleet, campaigns, social media and sales material

parrafos: During our time leading design at GSP Seguridad, we handled the company's visual communication end to end, developing solutions for branding, advertising, corporate communication, social media and sales material.
The project included an identity update, a visual redesign of the website, a 3D logo animation, corporate pieces, fleet design and advertising campaigns for security, alarms and cameras.

On the commercial side we developed catalogs, brochures, presentations and manuals, turning technical information into clear, attractive and useful resources. We also created the visual line for social media, including the Instagram feed, story highlights and adaptations for LinkedIn and Facebook.
A more coherent, professional and competitive visual communication system, designed both for its aesthetics and for its commercial and communication purpose.

ficha: Latex paint, spray paint, roller and brush

bloques.destacado: Don David was going through a complete makeover: changes inside, a redefined commercial offer and a new name, Blend David. The mural was the last stage of that process and the first thing the public would see.
parrafos: The brief was to paint the entire façade —5.5 meters high by 8.5 meters wide, almost 47 m²— and bring to the street a transformation that until then only existed inside the store.

The starting point was the word that names the store: blend. From there came an abstract language built from fluid shapes, spills and organic masses that intertwine, like liquids in motion before they fully mix.

Deep black as the background, supporting the store's night-time presence and making the other colors pop. On top of it, magenta and violet, with yellow as an accent. Three colors on black: enough to make an impact from a distance without overloading the façade.

The mural is built around the sign: the shapes open and close around the logo, letting it breathe at the center. The piece continues under the awning and down to the ground-floor panels, so the whole façade reads as a single work.
Seven working days, coordinated with the reopening schedule. The result established the new name in the public space: today the façade is the brand's main identity asset.

equilibria.subtitulo: Brand identity and full digital presence
equilibria.cta: Want a system like this for your brand?
ficha: Strategy, identity, website, content and digital management

bloques.destacado: The initial request was someone to run social media. But the practice had no website, no identity and no simple way to book: posting without that base was like starting with the roof.
parrafos: Verónica Rubilar has more than 20 years of experience in San Martín de los Andes, Argentina, and a reputation built by word of mouth. So we proposed an integral project with a simple goal: when someone recommends her, the other person can find her, see her work and book easily.

bloques.destacado: One system, five channels and a single destination: the practice’s WhatsApp.
parrafos: In a small town, people search on Google Maps. So we set priorities around the real patient journey: finding the practice on Google, getting to know the space on the website and Instagram, and getting in touch in one tap. The difference isn’t a device or a technique, it’s the care, and all the communication starts there.
Identity: three visual directions, a symbol of balancing stones, a logo in three versions, palette, typefaces and a brand voice for every channel.
Website: own domain, professional email and a custom 13-section site, designed mobile-first, with 9 WhatsApp shortcuts and local SEO.
Google and Maps: an optimized business profile, a 9-photo gallery and 14 designed posts, consistent details across channels and a direct link to request reviews.
WhatsApp Business: profile photo, cover, statuses, automated messages and messages to route and answer inquiries.
Instagram: 15 posts, 25 stories produced, 6 highlight covers, an optimized bio and an animated story.
Local promotion: flyers with QR codes in A4 and A6, ready for print, and a campaign for instructors to rent the gym.

In one month, Equilibria went from growing only by word of mouth to a full digital presence: 80 final pieces, 5 active integrated channels and a brand that looks the same on screen, on Google and on the street. Today, anyone searching for physical therapy in San Martín de los Andes can find the practice, get to know the space and book in just a few steps.

parrafos: AFFUM makes artisanal smoked foods and preserves in El Bolsón, Patagonia: trout, deer and wild boar. It needed a brand and packaging that conveyed Patagonian tradition and quality.

We designed the logo, with a red stroke of smoke over the “u”, and built a black-and-white system around it: jar and lid labels with product information and a QR code, and an Instagram feed with black-and-white Patagonian photography.
A sober, recognizable identity that works just as well on a jar, a lid or a post, and presents the product as gourmet.
